raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to synthesize existing results and prematurely concluded that the birth year of Mahbub ul Haq had not been retrieved when credible information had been presented earlier in Step 6 (from Wikipedia) showing his birth year as 1934. This error stopped the process from progressing effectively and led to repeated attempts to gather the same information without acknowledging or utilizing the available evidence. The Planner exhibited a repetitive instruction cycle without verifying the sufficiency of prior data, resulting in task redundancy and stagnation.
